To address your time management challenge with digital painting, consider shifting your creative sessions to the morning. Since you are creatively drained in the evening, your mental energy is likely fresher in the morning. Try dedicating 30 to 60 minutes to painting right after waking up or before starting your work as a web developer. This approach leverages your peak cognitive state for creative tasks and prevents the hobby from becoming a source of stress after a long day of coding. Additionally, you might try "micro-sessions" of 15 minutes during lunch breaks to maintain momentum without feeling overwhelmed.
